title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


What we're looking for

  • At least 4 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or model eval pipelines
  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate
  • A history of writing internal documentation that people actually reference

Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / DevOps role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly.


You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly , and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments.


  • Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments.
  • Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts.
  • Hands‑on production experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage.
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations , including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices.
  • Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends.
  • Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines.
  • Solid reliability engineering experience , including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety.
  • Scripting ability using Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate infrastructure development, incident response, and documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with VP-level stakeholders during architectural reviews and operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and own Azure cloud architecture for a greenfield PEG platform , including subscription structure, networking, identity, and environment separation.
  • Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services , ensuring high availability and operational resilience.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation.
  • Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments.
  • Design and maintain monitoring and alerting strategies across platform services, ensuring visibility into availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues, coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Improve platform reliability, automation, and developer experience through proactive runbook creation and operational documentation.
  • Partner with security and engineering stakeholders on network policies, access controls, private connectivity, and compliance requirements.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments.
  • Expertise operating Kubernetes/AKS workloads and Azure PaaS services in production contexts.
  • IaC background with Terraform , including environment separation and state management at scale.
  • Use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. Frontend & User Experience

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software

  • Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture

What We Offer

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Python / Go or Node.js or Java)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and either Golang, Node.js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

This is a role where you own the details, drive the follow-through, and hold leadership accountable—even when it’s uncomfortable. If you need permission to take initiative, this isn’t the right fit. If you’re the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen, keep reading.


About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn’t optional here. It’s embedded in how we work.


We’re building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That’s what this role is.


About the Role

You’ll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a “take notes and schedule meetings” role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what’s falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren’t getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.


The Director will be the first to tell you: he’s a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn’t afraid to say “Hey, this still isn’t done and it needs to be.” If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.


You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.


What Makes You Different

We’ve titled this section intentionally. We’re not looking for a generic set of skills—we’re looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:


  • You’re a Self-Starter. You don’t wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don’t ask “Should I do this?”—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they’re communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you’re checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they’d send an invoice, you’re following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You’re not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he’d review something and hasn’t, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn’t confrontation—it’s how things actually get done.
  • You’re Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don’t let things slide because it’s easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You’re the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You’re Committed to Your Own Growth. You’re not just looking for a job—you’re looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.


A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can’t wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won’t be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who’s willing to engage. It’s a two-way street built on mutual respect.


Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director’s task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what’s overdue
  • Serve as the “closing engine” that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed


Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren’t aspirational posters on a wall. They’re how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:


  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems


Who Thrives in This Role


You thrive here if you’re the person who:

•  Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

•  Constantly asks: “How can this be automated or improved?”

•  Has been told “You’re more organized than my actual manager”

•  Isn’t intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

•  Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

•  Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball


What’s in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development


One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought “That’s me”—we want to hear from you. We’d rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.

Team Office Meetings:

Python and Backend:

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer

O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.

  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

title: Market Data Database Support Engineer
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide.


About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database .

This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment , working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced diagnosis and root cause analysis of production incidents related to market data systems
  • Support and troubleshoot time-series databases
  • Analyze data quality issues (missing, delayed, or incorrect market data)
  • Investigate system behavior using logs, queries, and system-level tools
  • Work with real-time data distribution systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Validate data using tools such as Refinitiv SLang
  • Collaborate with vendors (e.g. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) , Bloomberg) to resolve data-related issues
  • Support incident management processes and ensure timely resolution
  • Develop small scripts (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for troubleshooting and automation
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and support processes


Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in production support / application support
  • Proven expertise in diagnosis and root cause analysis (RCA)
  • Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation)
  • Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis
  • Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments
  • Knowledge of market data systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Experience with Refinitiv SLang
  • Familiarity with Process Monitor (ProcMon) or similar diagnostic tools
  • Exposure to Bloomberg or Refinitiv/LSEG data platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong investigative mindset – you enjoy digging into complex issues
  • Ability to trace problems across multiple layers (data source → ingestion → database → application)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with global stakeholders
  • Structured and analytical thinking
  • Proactive approach to identifying and solving issues

What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento.

  • Vivência atuando como referência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe;
  • Capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade.

title: Data Scientist - Catálogo
description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Catálogo , com foco em qualidade, enriquecimento e padronização de dados de produtos, utilizando técnicas de Inteligência artificial.

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução do catálogo como ativo central do negócio, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia, Design e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções baseadas em IA e Machine Learning para enriquecimento automático de produtos, como:
  • Padronização de descrições e títulos
  • Inferência e sugestão de atributos
  • Classificação e reclassificação de produtos


  • Atuar na definição e otimização de:
  • Modelos e regras de categorização de produtos
  • Estratégias de enriquecimento e validação automática de atributos
  • Métricas de qualidade de catálogo (completude, consistência, acurácia e unicidade)


  • Trabalhar com modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo abordagens baseadas em NLP e LLMs, quando aplicável.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas que conectem qualidade de catálogo com impacto em negócio e experiência do usuário (ex: conversão, busca, recomendação).
  • Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar o impacto das melhorias de enriquecimento e qualidade do catálogo.
  • Traduzir problemas de negócio e operacionais em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados escaláveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio na definição do roadmap técnico de catálogo.
  • Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento das soluções baseadas em IA.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados.

  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital.
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: BigQuery, data lakes).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados.
  • Vivência com detecção de anomalias e métricas de qualidade de dados.

  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado a dados de produtos (ex: normalização de descrições, extração de atributos).
  • Conhecimento em visualização de dados e storytelling analítico.

Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role:


Working closely with established Account Managers, the Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for identifying opportunities to grow JoVE’s K12 subscribers. The BDR plays a key role in the sales process, engaging potential subscribers at every stage—from initial prospecting through to closing.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct cold calls, emails, and meetings to understand the user needs, priorities and timelines
  • Schedule meetings or product demos for the sales team with qualified leads
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop custom marketing materials

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales, preferably within SaaS or Edtech markets
  • Competitive, self-motivated, and resilient

Why Join JoVE?

  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Senior Software Engineer (Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica)
description:
Senior Software Engineer


About the Role

This role is focused on backend development, specifically supporting the migration of our customer support platform from Zendesk to Gladly, as well as maintaining and extending the integration services that power our support operations.

You'll be embedded in a small, collaborative engineering team working directly with Customer Support and Ticketing Platform teams. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, take pride in owning your code end-to-end, and enjoy meaningful technical work — this role is for you.


What You'll Be Working On:

  • Lead and contribute to the ongoing migration of our customer support system from Zendesk to Gladly, with a go-live planned.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and integration layers within our Ruby on Rails monolith
  • Build and support internal integration services that connect our support platforms with core business systems
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and collaborative planning sessions
  • Own the quality of your work — writing tests, performing developer-driven QA, and ensuring production readiness without a dedicated QA engineer
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Support Representative (CSR) teams and ticketing platform stakeholders


Tech Stack:

  • Primary: Ruby, Ruby on Rails
  • Architecture: Rails monolith + separate integration services
  • Supporting: REST APIs, JSON, internal tooling


What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Ruby development skills are a must
  • Solid experience building and maintaining backend services and API integrations
  • Comfort working without a dedicated QA team you own testing and production readiness
  • Experience working in Agile environments (sprints, code reviews, ceremonies)
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Gladly and/or Zendesk
  • Background in platform migrations
  • Full-stack exposure (React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS) beneficial for potential future team movement
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or Kafka

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .

Diferenciais

title: System Architect
description:
Project Description:

Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and own end-to-end vision system architecture (sensor → ISP → CV/ML → application layer).
  • Translate product and UX requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals.
  • Architect reusable, modular CV/ML frameworks across multiple product SKUs.
  • Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, cost, and thermal limits.
  • Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment.
  • Architect heterogeneous compute utilization (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP).
  • Define system KPIs: latency, FPS, power, memory, boot time, and robustness.
  • Lead technology selection for inference engines, frameworks, and hardware platforms.
  • Guide SoC bring-up and performance validation for vision pipelines.
  • Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability.
  • Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams.
  • Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance.
  • Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems.
  • Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI.
  • Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact).
  • Strong embedded system architecture experience.
  • Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge.
  • Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration.
  • Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs.
  • Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures.
  • Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills.

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis , essa vaga é para você.


Sobre a Tipspace

A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.


Tecnologias do Projeto

Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:

  • Bancos de Dados relacionais
  • Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
  • SQL para consultas estruturadas
  • Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
  • Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código


Responsabilidades

Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
  • Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
  • Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
  • Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
  • Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção.


Requisitos

Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:

  • Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
  • Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
  • Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
  • Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso.


Benefícios e Condições

  • Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
  • Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
  • Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
  • Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
  • Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa.


Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!


Boa sorte e até breve

title: AI Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

﻿

Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an AI Engineer who has built agents that are live in production at real companies, not demos, not prototypes that died after a pitch, not research projects. We need someone who has shipped agentic systems that enterprises depend on every day, and who understands the full lifecycle: scoping the business problem, designing the agent architecture, integrating with messy enterprise systems, building evaluation and monitoring, and keeping it running reliably.


This role sits across two priorities equally: building their internal multi agent AI platform and delivering agent based solutions directly to enterprise clients. You will work closely with their engineering team and the Managing Partner. You will have significant autonomy and direct impact on both the product and the business.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and deploy AI agents and multi agent systems that solve real business problems for enterprise clients.
  • Architect and implement agent orchestration, coordination, handoffs, shared state, and communication between specialized agents within their multi agent platform.
  • Integrate agents with enterprise systems (ERPs, CRMs, accounting platforms, APIs) to execute workflows end to end in production environments.
  • Build evaluation frameworks and production monitoring for deployed agents, logging agent decisions, tracking accuracy, cost, and latency, and implementing feedback loops.
  • Work within client systems to understand existing workflows and translate messy business processes into agent executable architectures.
  • Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns across engagements to accelerate future delivery.
  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of LLM capabilities, agent frameworks, implementation patterns, and the evolving AI product development stack.
  • Deliver technical artifacts including agent skills, sub agents, API integrations, and supporting infrastructure that will be used in production workflows.
  • Contribute to internal product development, shaping the architecture and capabilities of their platform alongside the engineering team.


Requirements:

  • Production agent experience:  You have built AI agents that are currently running in production for real companies. You can point to systems you built that people use every day.
  • Python proficiency:  Strong programming skills with Python as your primary language. You ship clean, maintainable production code.
  • LLM fluency:  Deep working knowledge of prompt engineering, context window management, and model selection. You know when to use a smaller model vs. a frontier model and why.
  • Enterprise integration experience:  You have connected agents to real business systems: ERPs (Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP), CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), accounting platforms (QuickBooks, Xero), or comparable enterprise APIs.
  • Evaluation and monitoring in production:  You have built observability into agents. You know how to log agent decisions, track accuracy and cost, and build feedback loops that improve agent performance over time.
  • Multi agent orchestration:  You have designed or built systems where multiple specialized agents coordinate, hand off tasks, and share state to accomplish complex workflows.
  • High agency:  You can take a messy business problem and turn it into a working agent architecture without hand holding. You thrive in ambiguity and move fast with minimal direction.
  • Portfolio / case study:  You must be able to walk us through at least one agent system you built that is live and being used by a real company. We want to understand the business problem, your architecture decisions, and how it is performing.


Nice to Haves:

  • TypeScript, Java, or a strong second language beyond Python.
  • Customer facing or consulting experience, you have worked directly with clients or stakeholders to scope and deliver technical projects.
  • Domain experience in financial services, CPG, legal, or the music industry.
  • Cost optimization thinking, token management, caching strategies, model routing to keep agent operating costs viable for clients.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Temporal, Airflow, Step Functions, or similar).
  • Former technical founder or early stage startup experience, you have worn many hats and shipped under resource constraints.


What We Offer:

  • Direct impact, you will shape both their products and their client engagements from day one.
  • Exposure to diverse enterprise AI challenges across multiple industries and verticals.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build AI systems used in real-world production environments.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

title: SDR - , , Brazil
description:
VAGA: SDR (SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE) - FIXADORES INDUSTRIAIS E ACESSÓRIOS.


SOBRE A EMPRESA

Somos uma importadora e distribuidora referência no segmento de fixadores (parafusos, porcas, arruelas, chumbadores, barras roscadas). Estamos em plena expansão digital e já estruturamos nosso setor de Inside Sales com base na metodologia \"Receita Previsível\" . Agora buscamos nosso primeiro SDR para alimentar o pipeline com leads qualificados e acelerar nosso crescimento.


SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADE

Você será o primeiro SDR da empresa , trabalhando em parceria direta com nosso Inside Sales Specialist para implementar a máquina de vendas previsível. Esta é uma oportunidade única de construir processos do zero , ser a porta de entrada de todos os leads digitais e participar ativamente de uma estratégia que visa 10x o volume de oportunidades qualificadas .


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Qualificar leads gerados pelo marketing digital e prospecção ativa, identificando oportunidades reais (SQL - Sales Qualified Leads) e passando-as para o Inside Sales, seguindo rigorosamente a metodologia \"Receita Previsível\" .


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

QUALIFICAÇÃO DE LEADS INBOUND (50%)

  • Contatar 100% dos leads em até 30 minutos após captura.
  • Realizar qualificação inicial usando metodologia BANT (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline).
  • Identificar dor, urgência e fit com nosso portfólio.
  • Nutrir leads que não estão prontos para compra (lead nurturing).

PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA OUTBOUND (30%)

  • Executar cadências de prospecção em leads definidos pelo marketing
  • Realizar cold calls e cold emails estruturados
  • Pesquisar empresas e tomadores de decisão no LinkedIn/Google
  • Gerar SQLs através de prospecção ativa
  • Mapear empresas do setor de construção civil, indústria e manutenção

GESTÃO DE PIPELINE E PROCESSOS (15%)

  • Manter CRM 100% atualizado e organizado.
  • Documentar todas as interações com leads.
  • Seguir e otimizar playbooks de qualificação
  • Registrar objeções e padrões identificados
  • Participar de reuniões de forecast e planejamento

ALINHAMENTO COM MARKETING E INSIDE SALES (5%)

  • Fornecer feedback diário sobre qualidade dos leads por canal
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento (marketing + vendas)
  • Colaborar no aprimoramento de ICPs (Ideal Customer Profile) e personas
  • Sugerir melhorias nas campanhas baseadas no contato com prospects


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência : Em vendas B2B, telemarketing qualificado ou atendimento comercial
  • Comunicação : Excelente dicção, persuasão e escrita profissional
  • Resiliência : Capacidade de lidar com \"não\" e fazer follow-ups consistentes
  • Organização : Disciplina para seguir processos e atualizar CRM diariamente
  • Perfil Hunter : Proatividade para prospecção ativa e busca de novas oportunidades

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Conhecimento do livro \"Receita Previsível\" ou \"Fanatical Prospecting\" (Jeb Blount)
  • Experiência com cold calling estruturado
  • Vivência no setor industrial, construção civil ou distribuição B2B
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Social Selling (LinkedIn Sales Navigator)
  • Conhecimento em metodologias BANT, GPCT ou MEDDIC

COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Persistência : Não desiste após o primeiro \"não\", segue cadências completas
  • Curiosidade : Faz perguntas para entender a fundo a dor do prospect
  • Coachability : Aceita feedback e implementa rapidamente melhorias
  • Orientação por métricas : Acompanha seus números e busca superá-los
  • Trabalho em equipe : Colabora efetivamente com Inside Sales e Marketing


METAS E INDICADORES:

PROGRESSÃO DE VOLUME

  • Mês 1-2 : 70-100 leads/dia (período de treinamento e ajuste)
  • Mês 3-4 : 100 - 150 leads/dia
  • Mês 5+ : 150 - 200+ leads/dia

ATIVIDADES DIÁRIAS ESPERADAS

  • 100 - 200 tentativas de contato (calls, emails, WhatsApp)
  • 30 - 40 conversas efetivas com decisores
  • 8-12 SQLs gerados por dia (pós-rampa)


REMUNERAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS:

ESTRUTURA SALARIAL

  • Salário Base : R$ 2.800,00
  • Comissão por SQL Aceito : Valor específico por SQL aprovado pelo Inside Sales (Critérios definidos após contratação).
  • Bônus Trimestral : R$ 1.000,00 (atingimento de 100% da meta do setor comercial)

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Vale refeição : R$ 26,00 por dia útil

PLANO DE CARREIRA:

  • 6 meses : SDR Pleno (transição baseada em performance) .
  • 12 meses : SDR Sênior (liderança de novos SDRs) (transição baseada em performance) .
  • 18-24 meses : Promoção para Inside Sales Specialist (transição baseada em performance) .


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS:

  • Modalidade: Presencial;
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta, 8h às 17:48h;
