Echosens has made FibroScan® available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.

Echosens is shaping the future of liver health . As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.

In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH ), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.


Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.


To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:


CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)

LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)


The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.


This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.



Main activities:


  • Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens FibroScan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
  • Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
  • Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
  • Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise


Experience / Education / Special Requirements



You have a bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.


You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.


Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.


You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.



Please submit your application and CV in English.

title: Web & Mobile App UI/UX Designer
description:
About Chop Dawg


Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Chop Dawg builds custom mobile apps, web platforms, and AI products for partners worldwide. We've launched over 500 apps with a 92% partner retention rate, working with everyone from first-time founders to Fortune 500 companies, including NASA, The White House, Jefferson Health, Six Flags, Wawa, Hilton, the NFL, and the U.S. Navy. Our teams span across the United States, Brazil, and Pakistan.


We don't call our clients \"clients.\" We call them partners, because that's the relationship we build. We're not a vendor you hire and check in with at the end. We're in it with you from day one, and this role is at the heart of how our partners experience the products we create together.


The Role


You GOTTA love designing apps. Not just making screens look beautiful, but thinking deeply about how users interact with digital products, how they move through an experience, and how great design decisions lead to great outcomes.


As a Web & Mobile App UI/UX Designer at Chop Dawg, you'll be joining our growing Brazilian design team of 9 designers, working alongside 2 American designers, as part of an 11-person creative powerhouse. You'll work directly with our partners across the United States and beyond, translating their ideas into thoughtful, polished, and development-ready designs.


This is a full-time, 40-hour per week commitment. Our designers typically manage 2 to 3 active partner projects at any given time, so you need to be someone who thrives juggling multiple workstreams, staying organized, and delivering quality work across all of them without missing a beat.


Every project is different. Our partners span industries and stages, from first-time founders with a napkin sketch to established companies looking to build their next big product. What stays consistent is the standard: every product we design should be something our partners are proud to launch and their users love to use.


What You'll Do


  • Design mobile apps, web applications, marketing websites, and branding assets for partners across a wide range of industries
  • Manage your workload across 2 to 3 concurrent projects, keeping each one moving forward on schedule and at a high standard
  • Create user personas, site maps, wireframes, low-fidelity and high-fidelity designs, product flows, and documentation
  • Build and maintain component libraries that keep design systems consistent across projects
  • Develop non-functional prototypes to validate design direction before development begins
  • Design branding elements including app icons, logo designs, and Apple App Store and Google Play Store assets
  • Collaborate directly with partners via Zoom to present work, gather feedback, and refine direction
  • Work closely with project managers, developers, and fellow designers through Slack, Jira, and Confluence to keep projects moving
  • Participate in design reviews and iterate based on partner and team feedback
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude and Google Stitch to enhance your workflow and output quality


What We're Looking For


Required


  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken. This is non-negotiable. You will be communicating directly with American partners daily, and clear, professional English is essential.
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connection
  • Available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating experience designing mobile apps, web applications, and branding
  • Proficiency with Figma as your primary design tool
  • Experience with user personas, site mapping, wireframing, high-fidelity design, product flows, non-functional prototyping, and component libraries
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Experience working directly with partners and teams based in the United States
  • Experience working in an agency setting, ideally serving American or European clientele
  • Proficiency with Slack and Zoom for daily communication and partner meetings
  • Available to start immediately or within the next few weeks


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing for wearable devices and tablets
  • Familiarity with Jira and Confluence
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered design and productivity tools such as Claude and Google Stitch
  • Previous project management experience
  • Background in branding including app icons, logo design, and app store asset creation


Compensation


Starting at $1,000 USD/month, scaling up to $4,500 USD/month as you grow into the role and take on expanded responsibilities.


Availability


Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST. This is a full-time, 40-hour per week position. Must be based in Brazil.


Reports To:  Design leadership and CEO/CTO


Why Chop Dawg


We don't chase volume. We invest in relationships. That's how we've maintained a 92% partner retention rate and built a portfolio that spans startups, government agencies, and some of the most recognized brands in the world. Our Brazilian design team is growing because the talent is exceptional, and we want you to be part of that growth story. You won't be designing in a silo. You'll be collaborating with a tight-knit, international team that genuinely cares about the work and the people we do it for.


If you take pride in your craft, love working on products that matter to real people, and want to be part of a team that treats design as the foundation of everything we build, we'd love to see your work.


How to Apply


Apply directly through this posting. Include a link to your portfolio. Tell us about your design experience, the types of products you've worked on, and what drew you to this role.


Chop Dawg is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?

Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer (LLMs, RAG & Agents)


Estamos em busca de um AI Engineer para atuar na evolução da nossa plataforma com foco na construção de sistemas inteligentes baseados em LLMs, agentes e bases de conhecimento.


Essa pessoa fará parte do time de engenharia e será responsável por desenvolver soluções de IA aplicadas ao produto, integrando modelos de linguagem com dados reais, sistemas internos e fluxos de negócio.


Nosso objetivo é construir uma plataforma orientada a inteligência artificial, com uso de RAG, agentes e múltiplas bases de conhecimento (relacionais, vetoriais e grafos), aplicadas a contextos educacionais e corporativos.


Não buscamos um perfil acadêmico ou focado em treinamento de modelos. Buscamos alguém que saiba transformar IA em produto real.


O que você vai fazer:


  • Desenvolver funcionalidades baseadas em LLMs integradas à plataforma
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Estruturar e evoluir bases de conhecimento (dados estruturados, vetoriais e grafos)
  • Construir e orquestrar agentes e fluxos de execução (tools, multi-agents, etc.)
  • Integrar IA com sistemas existentes (APIs, banco de dados, serviços internos)
  • Trabalhar na qualidade das respostas (avaliação, melhoria contínua, contexto)
  • Otimizar custo, latência e performance das aplicações de IA
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia na evolução da arquitetura da plataforma


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com uso de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • Experiência com construção de RAG e uso de embeddings
  • Experiência com integração de IA em aplicações reais (não apenas protótipos)
  • Conhecimento em APIs, backend e integração entre sistemas
  • Capacidade de estruturar e trabalhar com diferentes tipos de dados
  • Experiência com debugging e evolução de sistemas em produção
  • Mentalidade de engenharia (performance, custo, confiabilidade)


Stack e Tecnologias (IA e Dados):


  • LLMs e APIs de IA (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Bases vetoriais (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares)
  • Bases de grafos e conhecimento (Neo4j ou similares)
  • Orquestração de agentes (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno ou abordagens próprias)
  • Integração com APIs e serviços internos
  • Backend para orquestração (Node.js, Python ou PHP)


Perfil esperado:


  • Consegue transformar IA em funcionalidades reais de produto
  • Pensa em dados, contexto e qualidade de resposta
  • Não depende de frameworks específicos para resolver problemas
  • Consegue trabalhar com autonomia e explorar soluções
  • Equilibra experimentação com responsabilidade técnica

title: Payroll Analyst
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

This team is responsible for the ongoing coordination of payroll processing activities, including the collection and validation of payroll inputs, and the validation and controls of monthly payroll run outputs, with the overarching objective of processing salaries in a timely and accurate manner across the region. The team liaises continuously with multiple internal stakeholders (employees, HR and Finance colleagues) and the outsourced payroll services provider, providing expert advice on payroll-related topics.


Job Description

The Payroll Analyst is responsible for the complete, end-to-end management and execution of the payroll cycle for the Brazilian entity, ensuring flawless accuracy, strict legal compliance, and maximum process efficiency.

This professional will serve as the primary payroll and Personnel Administration (DP) subject matter expert (SME), closely collaborating with the Finance, Human Resources, and Occupational Health and Safety teams to ensure the accurate interpretation and application of all national labor laws and their financial implications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Payroll Operations: Manage and execute the full payroll lifecycle, including data entry, processing, advances, monthly closing, and managing all related bank transactions.
  • Compliance & Regulatory Reporting (DP Focus): Ensure absolute compliance with all local taxes, statutory obligations, and labor legislation (CLT). This includes managing specific government requirements such as eSocial, eConsignado, and other mandated regulatory reporting.
  • Financial Reconciliation: Lead the complex payroll general ledger account reconciliation process and coordinate the period closing activities with the Accounting and Finance teams.
  • Absence & Leave Management: Oversee and accurately process all employee events related to Personnel Administration (DP), including absences, sick leaves, medical leaves, and temporary contract suspensions and legally mandated leaves, ensuring adherence to company policy and legal requirements.
  • Policy & Audit Support: Review, develop, and update internal payroll and DP policies and procedures. Act as the key contact and support resource for both internal and external audits.
  • System Administration: Configure and maintain the payroll system (e.g., ADP) to reflect new rules, regulations, and benefit changes. Manage all payments to payroll-related third-party vendors.
  • Strategic Reporting: Develop and deliver insightful managerial reports and in-depth analyses of payroll processes to support business decision-making and forecasting.


Basic Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Accounting, or Human Resources Management, with a strong focus or specialization in Personnel Administration (Departamento Pessoal - DP).
  • Experience: Proven, extensive experience in end-to-end payroll processing and administration in a complex environment.
  • Legal Expertise: Deep knowledge and understanding of local Brazilian Labor Legislation (CLT) and associated union/collective bargaining obligations.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in payroll systems (e.g., ADP is highly preferred), Advanced Excel skills, and experience with Google Workspace/Tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Demonstrated ability to perform complex account reconciliation, proactively identify issues, and resolve discrepancies quickly and accurately.
  • Analytical Ability: Strong capacity to gather data, perform complex analysis, and develop clear, actionable managerial reports.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential for effective interaction with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and auditors.
  • Language: Advanced English proficiency is required. Spanish proficiency is desirable.


EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Clinical Trial Manager / Senior Clinical Trial Manager
description:
Clinical Trial Manager (CTM)/Sr CTM, Clinical Operations


Nexcella, Inc.


Our 3 Core Values

  • Intelligence
  • Integrity
  • Initiative


What You'll Do

The Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) leads the strategic and operational execution of cell therapy clinical trials, owning the full patient treatment pathway from apheresis through manufacturing, product release, and infusion. Serving as the cross-functional integrator across Clinical Operations, CMC, Manufacturing, Regulatory, Medical, Quality, and Supply Chain. The CTM ensures seamless execution, strict chain of identity and custody, inspection readiness, and on-time delivery of critical study milestones while safeguarding patient safety and product integrity


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the day-to-day operational execution of assigned cell therapy trials: study startup, site activation, enrollment, monitoring, close-out.
  • Develop and manage study timelines, budgets, forecasts, and related operational metrics.
  • Partner with external vendors / CROs / service providers (monitoring, labs, imaging, manufacturing/supply chain for cell product) to ensure high quality and timely deliverables.
  • Serve as the primary cross-functional operational contact for study teams (clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, regulatory, safety/pharmacovigilance, manufacturing, supply chain, medical affairs, quality).
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and quality standards (FDA, EMA, ICH-GCP, relevant local regulations) and internal SOPs.
  • Participate in protocol development and amendments, informed consent form (ICF) review, CRF/data tool development, TMF (Trial Master File) setup & maintenance, monitoring plan, data review plan, drug/cell-product accountability and reconciliation.
  • Oversee site feasibility, selection, contracting, start‐up (site initiation visits, training, enrollment & retention strategies) and close‐out activities.
  • Monitor study progress, identify risks/issues (enrollment delays, monitor/vendor performance, budget overruns, data quality issues) and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Foster effective communication across study teams, escalate issues to senior leadership as needed.
  • Ensure preparation for audits/inspections, maintain high standards of documentation readiness.
  • Contribute to lessons-learned and process improvement initiatives, particularly around cell-therapy-specific operational challenges (e.g., chain of identity/chain of custody, logistics of product, unique site training).
  • Review invoices and track study budget according to the forecast, working closely with finance and clinical business operations.
  • Develop study documents and tools including study, informed consent forms, project plans, budgets, study templates, and other materials as needed.
  • Vendor Management – Contribute to or lead cross-program vendor management activities
  • Contribute to SOP development within the Clinical Operations team

Qualifications

  • B.S. degree with minimum 7-10 years of experience in clinical operations including managing clinical trials in biotech, pharmaceutical.
  • Strong clinical study conduct experience from start-up through close-out.
  • Strong leadership, effective decision making, and problem-solving skills required.
  • Established Cell Therapy /CAR T study experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of relevant GCPs and FDA/EMA regulations.
  • Knowledgeable of current ICH GCP guidelines and applicable regulations.
  • Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision and multi-task activities to effectively manage deliverables across all trials.
  • Experience in small/mid biotechnology environment (startup mindset)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills


About Nexcella, Inc.

Nexcella, Inc. is a subsidiary of Immix Biopharma, Inc. (ImmixBio) (Nasdaq: IMMX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201 with a “digital filter” that filters out non-specific activation. NXC-201 is being evaluated in the U.S. multi-center study for relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis NEXICART-2 (NCT ), with a registrational design. Interim results were presented at ASCO 2025 in an oral presentation by Heather Landau, M.D. of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. title: Senior Asterisk Specialist / LATAM
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly experienced Asterisk Specialist to join our Level 3 technical support team. This role combines deep hands-on development, tactical guidance, and partner engagement across our technical team. You will be the go-to expert for complex Asterisk core system troubleshooting and custom telephony solutions, working directly with customers and resellers while supporting our internal development teams. This role focuses on Asterisk's underlying engine, custom dialplan development, and advanced VoIP implementations


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities
  • Diagnose and resolve complex Asterisk configuration file and dialplan issues.
  • Troubleshoot core Asterisk functionality , channel drivers, and application problems.
  • Elevate telephony engineering skills across our team through mentorship, collaboration, and exemplification.
  • Support development teams with Asterisk AGI, AMI, and ARI integrations.
  • Assist with custom Asterisk builds , patches, and telephony application development.
  • Collaborate closely with technical teams across the enterprise to help transform complex telephony data into actionable insights.
  • Debug complex dialplan logic and custom Asterisk applications using full logs and real-time traces.
  • Optimize Asterisk performance , memory usage, and concurrent call handling for high-performance architecture.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation for Asterisk configuration patterns and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Establish team coding standards and best practices for dialplan programming and API integration.
  • Participate in our on-call schedule to help ensure availability of critical Asterisk core system services.
  • Provide advanced technical guidance to customers and resellers on custom Asterisk implementations.


Requirements
  • 8+ years of experience in engineering , including senior or lead experience in telephony environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience specifically with Asterisk configuration file management and dialplan development.
  • Deep expertise in Asterisk internals , including dialplan programming, channel configuration, and application development.
  • Advanced VoIP knowledge , covering SIP protocol internals, RTP, codec negotiation, and NAT handling.
  • Strong experience with Linux system administration and command-line expertise.
  • Proficiency in Asterisk debugging using CLI commands, logging levels, and protocol analysis.
  • Experience with custom development , specifically AGI scripts, custom applications, and API integrations.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and working within AWS cloud infrastructure services.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex telephony concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred qualifications include Asterisk module development in C, scripting expertise (Python, Perl, PHP), and database integration (Realtime, CDR)

Também reconhecemos a importância da diversidade geracional e temos orgulho em promover oportunidades para profissionais 50+, que fortalecem nosso time com suas experiências e trajetórias.


Venha crescer com a gente e fazer parte dessa história!

A área de Talentos e Desenvolvimento Organizacional (DO) é responsável por definir e implementar estratégias que fortaleçam as capacidades da organização e o pipeline de liderança. Apoio no desenvolvimento e retenção de talentos, além de estruturar programas e assessments alinhados às prioridades do negócio.


Missão do Cargo:

Atuar na estruturação, integração e evolução do modelo de gestão de performance da organização, com forte foco em indicadores e análise de dados. A posição será responsável por conduzir a unificação do ciclo de metas e do ciclo de talentos, garantindo consistência metodológica, governança do processo e alinhamento com as prioridades estratégicas do negócio.


Principais desafios:

Conduzir a integração e unificação do ciclo de metas e do ciclo de avaliação de talentos, garantindo alinhamento entre estratégia, resultados das áreas e metas individuais.

Estruturar e acompanhar indicadores de performance, garantindo análise de dados e geração de insights para apoiar decisões de liderança e RH.

Monitorar dashboards e relatórios de acompanhamento do ciclo de performance, assegurando visibilidade e governança do processo.

Atuar na implantação e melhoria contínua do modelo de gestão de performance, garantindo padronização e eficiência do processo.

Conduzir treinamentos e ações de capacitação para líderes e colaboradores sobre o ciclo de metas, avaliação de desempenho e gestão de resultados.

Garantir a governança e o cumprimento das etapas do ciclo de performance, acompanhando prazos, aderência e qualidade das avaliações.

Atuar como ponto de referência para análises relacionadas à performance organizacional, contribuindo para a evolução da cultura de gestão orientada a resultados.


Você precisa ter:

Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;

Excel avançado;

Experiência em gestão de performance, avaliação de desempenho ou gestão de metas corporativas;

Forte capacidade analítica e experiência no acompanhamento de indicadores e análise de dados;

Experiência em gestão de projetos e condução de processos corporativos;

Habilidade de comunicação e facilitação de treinamentos para diferentes públicos;


Adoraríamos se você tiver:

Profissional com forte capacidade analítica e orientação a dados, capaz de conectar metas, resultados e estratégia do negócio;

Perfil organizado e estruturado, com garantia de governança e eficiência nos processos de performance;

Atuação com foco em resultados, comunicação clara e influência junto a stakeholders, além de protagonismo, colaboração e busca contínua por melhoria de modelos e ferramentas de gestão de desempenho.

title: Especialista de Segurança da Informação II (DevSecOps).
description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver ferramentas de cibersegurança: Criar e manter scanners de vulnerabilidades, monitoramento de ameaças e integrações SIEM para suporte operacional ao time de ops.
  • Suporte cross-team dedicado: Atuar como ponte entre times de dev (segurança em código) e ops (operação de ferramentas), realizando code reviews, threat modeling e automação de conformidade (OWASP Top 10, CIS Benchmarks).
  • Monitoramento e resposta a incidentes: Configurar e otimizar alertas em ambientes cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), com ênfase em IAM, WAF e zero-trust para ferramentas críticas.
  • Evolução de processos: Documentar pipelines seguros, treinar equipes em IaC (Terraform/Helm) e contribuir para políticas de segurança em contêineres (Kubernetes/Docker).
  • Otimização contínua: Analisar métricas de segurança em produção, propor melhorias em ferramentas customizadas e garantir conformidade LGPD/PCI-DSS.
  • Identificar riscos e liderar soluções de segurança end-to-end.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Possuir certificações CSSLP, CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist) ou AWS/GCP/Azure Security Specialty.
  • Experiência com DevSecOps e suporte cross-team.
  • Proficiência em CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions) e IaC (Terraform, Helm, Ansible) para integração de segurança shift-left.
  • Experiência com SAST/DAST/SCA (SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, Snyk), scanners de contêineres (Clair, Grype) e runtime security (Falco).
  • Experiência com l inguagens e infraestrutura: Python ou Go para automação de ferramentas de segurança; Kubernetes/Docker para orquestração segura; scripts em Bash/PowerShell.
  • Experiência com Cloud Nativa: Hands-on em AWS (Security Hub, GuardDuty, IAM, WAF, Secrets Manager), GCP ou Azure (Defender for Cloud), com foco em políticas de zero-trust e detecção de ameaças.
  • Domínio em OWASP Top 10, CIS Benchmarks, pipelines seguros e conformidade LGPD/PCI-DSS/GDPR.
  • Experiência com equipes multidisciplinares, atuando como ponte entre Desenvolvedores, Ops e Stakeholders.


Informações adicionais

  • Experiência com PCI-DSS e ISO 27001.
  • Experiência com ferramentas: Sysdig, ELK Stack, Hashicorp Vault, PKI e Certificados, Segurança em Terminais.
  • Certificações OSCP, CEH ou DevSecOps (ex.: Docker CAP, Kubernetes Security).


Olá, somos o PagBank!

Talvez você nos conheça por maquininhas ou comerciais que ficam na memória, mas somos muito mais!

Com tecnologia

O espírito disruptivo e inovador está no nosso DNA: somos parte do Grupo UOL, empresa 100% brasileira, foi pioneira na internet e transforma a vida das pessoas desde 1996.


Com uma só cultura

Temos uma cultura forte e única, capaz de nos levar além, para continuarmos crescendo e perpetuando o nosso negócio.


Somos um dos maiores bancos digitais do país e uma das fintechs mais rentáveis do segmento.


Para vivenciar tudo isso, você terá um pacote completo de benefícios que fazem toda a diferença:

  • Vale-alimentação e/ou refeição.

  • Descontos de até 50% em pós-graduação e MBA de grandes instituições, como FIA, FAAP e PUCRS.

Orientação forte a resultados e crescimento

  • Curiosidade constante sobre comportamento de audiência e tendências digitais

100% remoto.

R$ 12 mil, contratação PJ.


Interessados(as), enviar currículo e portfólio para: .

O Amado Mundo é uma startup digital de comunicação com atuação no YouTube ( site ( e redes sociais. Nossa missão é criar conversas que traduzem a complexidade do mundo contemporâneo em contexto, repertório e reflexões para a vida adulta.

title: AI Program Manager
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled AI Program Manager to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil, Bulgaria, or Romania. Candidates who are able to work hybrid from our Sofia, Bulgaria or São Carlos, Brazil offices will be given preference.

Industry: IT & Services


AI Program Manager | About You

As an AI Program Manager, you are responsible for coordinating and driving execution across AI‑focused software delivery teams. You bring strong experience supporting programs that involve machine learning workflows, data governance, model development, and cloud‑based AI product delivery. You thrive in Agile environments and excel at bringing structure, alignment, and predictability to complex cross‑team initiatives. You communicate clearly with engineering, product, and data science partners, ensuring dependencies, risks, and priorities are well understood. You are detail‑oriented, highly organized, and skilled at maintaining governance standards while enabling teams to deliver AI capabilities efficiently and consistently.


AI Program Manager | Day-to-Day

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies for AI and ML engineering PODs, ensuring all teams follow established AI delivery frameworks and governance processes.
  • Coordinate planning activities with Product, ML Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Architecture by documenting requirements, dependencies, milestones, and risks.
  • Maintain governance artifacts including schedules, RAID logs, decision records, and AI‑specific delivery documentation.
  • Track progress across AI workstreams, capturing updates from sprint reviews, model checkpoints, training cycles, and evaluation sessions.
  • Support cross‑functional alignment by coordinating client engagement logistics, AI use‑case prioritization, and model delivery readiness.
  • Prepare bi‑weekly delivery reports summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and upcoming AI release milestones using Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.


AI Program Manager | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience supporting software, SaaS, or AI/ML delivery programs in an Agile environment.
  • Proven experience coordinating AI‑enabled product development, including data pipelines, model training workflows, feature engineering, or ML deployment cycles.
  • Strong ability to manage inter‑team dependencies and align work across Product, ML Engineering, Data Science, and Cloud Engineering teams.
  • Experience maintaining program schedules, RAID logs, delivery documentation, and governance artifacts across multiple PODs or workstreams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, and Confluence, including structured reporting and dashboard creation.
  • Familiarity with AI delivery concepts including data governance, model lifecycle stages, technical risks, and responsible AI considerations.

Descrição da Vaga


Na RPS - Real Property Solution , temos um compromisso permanente com a excelência, a preservação do patrimônio e a satisfação de nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais experientes e dedicados que contribuem para o desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas e estratégicas no mercado imobiliário.

Atuamos com clientes nacionais e internacionais, oferecendo uma experiência diferenciada em consultoria, gestão e análise técnica de ativos imobiliários.


Descrição da Posição


O Supervisor Técnico Predial exerce um papel fundamental no apoio às atividades de vistoria, diagnóstico técnico e análise das condições físicas de empreendimentos imobiliários.

Este profissional atua diretamente em inspeções multidisciplinares, auxiliando na identificação de patologias construtivas, verificação de conformidades técnicas e análise das condições de sistemas prediais e infraestrutura.

Além da atuação em campo, o profissional também contribui para a organização das informações coletadas, elaboração de relatórios técnicos e apoio à equipe de gestão na interpretação dos dados levantados, contribuindo para a preservação patrimonial e para o planejamento adequado das ações de manutenção e melhoria dos ativos imobiliários.

Espera-se que o profissional tenha forte atenção aos detalhes, organização e capacidade analítica para identificar riscos potenciais, registrar informações técnicas de forma clara e colaborar com soluções que promovam a segurança, eficiência e longevidade dos empreendimentos avaliados.


Principais Responsabilidades


• Apoiar a realização de inspeções prediais e vistorias técnicas em empreendimentos imobiliários e ativos sob gestão.

• Auxiliar na identificação de patologias construtivas, não conformidades técnicas e oportunidades de melhoria.

• Realizar levantamentos fotográficos e registros técnicos para elaboração de relatórios de inspeção.

• Apoiar a análise das condições de conservação e funcionamento dos sistemas prediais e infraestrutura.

• Organizar informações técnicas e colaborar na elaboração de relatórios de diagnóstico patrimonial.

• Contribuir para o acompanhamento de cronogramas de manutenção e ações corretivas identificadas nas inspeções.

• Apoiar a equipe técnica na leitura e interpretação de projetos e documentos técnicos.

• Colaborar com a equipe na proposição de soluções técnicas e recomendações de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.

Capacidade de apoiar inspeções multidisciplinares em diferentes sistemas e componentes da edificação, incluindo:


Civil

  • Identificação de fissuras, recalques, patologias construtivas e condições de acabamentos.
  • Avaliação preliminar da integridade estrutural e condições gerais das edificações.

Elétrica

  • Verificação de quadros de energia, fiação, aterramento e sistemas de iluminação.


Hidráulica

  • Identificação de vazamentos, análise de pressão de rede, barriletes e sistemas de esgoto.


Coberturas

  • Avaliação de telhas, calhas, rufos e sistemas de impermeabilização.


Infraestrutura

  • Verificação de pavimentação (asfalto ou paver), drenagem e estabilidade de taludes.


Sistemas de Incêndio

title: Analista Sênior de GRC (Governança, Riscos e Compliance)
description:
Descrição da Vaga: Estamos buscando um Analista Sênior de GRC altamente qualificado e experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por garantir a governança, o gerenciamento de riscos e a conformidade com as regulamentações e normas aplicáveis, com foco nos ambientes Microsoft Azure e M365. O candidato ideal possui vasta experiência em processos de auditoria interna e externa, elaboração de políticas, processos e controles, além de possuir certificações ISO 27001 e ISO 27701.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter o framework de GRC da empresa, alinhado com as melhores práticas e normas internacionais (ex: ISO 27001, ISO 27701, NIST, LGPD, GDPR).
  • Conduzir avaliações de riscos de segurança da informação e privacidade de dados nos ambientes internos e de clientes e parceiros.
  • Elaborar, revisar e atualizar políticas, processos, procedimentos e controles de segurança da informação e privacidade de dados.
  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar auditorias internas e externas, garantindo a conformidade com os requisitos normativos e regulatórios.
  • Gerenciar o programa de conscientização em segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, promovendo treinamentos e campanhas de comunicação.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento das políticas e controles de segurança, identificando desvios e propondo ações corretivas.
  • Suportar as equipes na implementação de controles de segurança nos ambientes Azure e M365.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para auditorias externas e internas, fornecendo informações e evidências necessárias.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências em GRC, segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, buscando constantemente aprimorar os processos e controles.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas da empresa (ex: Jurídico, Compliance, TI) para garantir a integração das atividades de GRC.
  • Acompanhar e interpretar as mudanças nas legislações e regulamentações relacionadas à segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, adaptando os processos internos conforme necessário.
  • Elaborar relatórios de GRC para a alta gestão, apresentando o status da conformidade, os riscos identificados e as ações implementadas.


Qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência em GRC, com foco em segurança da informação e privacidade de dados.
  • Profundo conhecimento das normas ISO 27001 e ISO 27701.
  • Experiência comprovada em condução de auditorias internas e externas.
  • Habilidade em elaborar políticas, processos, procedimentos e controles de segurança da informação e privacidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de segurança da informação (ex: NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls).
  • Conhecimento em regulamentações de privacidade de dados (ex: LGPD, GDPR).
  • Familiaridade com os serviços e recursos de segurança do Microsoft Azure e M365.
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e de forma independente.
  • Certificações ISO 27001 Lead Auditor ou Implementer
  • ISO 27701 Lead Auditor ou Implementer
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
  • Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP)
  • Microsoft certifications relacionadas a segurança em Azure e M365.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos utilizando metodologias como ISO 31000.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação de sistemas de gestão de segurança da informação e privacidade de dados.
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Ensino Superior completo em áreas de Tecnologia (Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação etc.).
